existing.description: MSCA Doctoral Networks implement doctoral programmes through international, intersectoral partnerships of universities, research institutions, businesses including SMEs and other socio-economic actors, in order to train highly skilled doctoral candidates. Besides standard Doctoral Networks, the action promotes Industrial Doctorates, which place PhD candidates largely outside academia, and Joint Doctorates, which lead to a joint or multiple doctoral degrees. Each beneficiary must recruit at least one doctoral candidate, who must not already hold a doctoral degree at recruitment, may be of any nationality and is funded through a living allowance, mobility allowance and applicable family, long-term leave and special needs allowances. The 2026 call is currently open, having launched on 28 May 2026 with a deadline of 24 November 2026.
eligibility: For the applicant consortium: at least three independent legal entities, each in a different EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country, with at least one in an EU Member State
Additional partner organisations from any country in the world may join the consortium
Specific conditions apply to Industrial Doctorates and Joint Doctorates
For the recruited researcher: must not hold a doctoral degree at the date of recruitment
For the recruited researcher: any nationality
For the recruited researcher: must be enrolled in a doctoral programme during the project
For Industrial Doctorates: at least 50% of time outside academia
For the recruited researcher: no more than 12 months of residence or main activity in the recruiting organisation's country in the 36 months immediately before recruitment
Each beneficiary must recruit at least one doctoral candidate
existing.eligibility_summary: Excellent researchers of any nationality holding a Master's degree or equivalent; mobility rule applies; open to those reintegrating to Europe or displaced by conflict.
benefits: Gross salary (approx. EUR 4,000-5,000/month depending on country and experience)
coverage: Gross salary (approx. EUR 4,000-5,000/month depending on country and experience)
application_method: Apply to funded Doctoral Network projects advertised on EURAXESS or institutional websites
existing.best_fit: PhD candidates seeking fully funded research training across EU Member States or Horizon Europe Associated Countries.
existing.notes: Part of Horizon Europe; Doctoral Networks are partnerships of universities, research institutions and businesses from different countries. Vacancies advertised on EURAXESS portal. Standard duration 3-4 years.
existing.duration: Doctoral Networks can last up to 4 years, up to 5 years for Joint Doctorate projects. Each individual fellowship is between 3 and 36 months, or 3 to 48 months for Joint Doctorate fellowships.
existing.application_period: Call opens May, deadline November annually
existing.program_type: EU doctoral training programme under Horizon Europe (MSCA Doctoral Networks), administered by the European Research Executive Agency

scholarships.title: Chevening Scholarship
scholarships.official_source: Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO), UK

existing.description: Chevening Scholarships allow exceptional individuals to study for a one-year master’s degree at a UK university.
eligibility: Be a citizen of a Chevening-eligible country or territory
Commit to returning to your home country for at least 2 years after your scholarship ends
Have at least 2 years' work experience (2,800 hours)
Hold an undergraduate degree that qualifies you for a UK master's programme
Apply to 3 different and eligible UK university courses
existing.eligibility_summary: Chevening-eligible country citizen, 2+ years work experience (2,800 hours), undergraduate degree qualifying for UK master's, return to home country for 2+ years after scholarship ends
requirements: Online application via Chevening online application system
documents: Online application (via Chevening online application system)
application_method: Apply via Chevening online application system at chevening.org/apply
If shortlisted, attend interview at British embassy/high commission
Secure unconditional offer from a UK university by deadline
existing.selection_notes: Applications sifted against eligibility criteria, then assessed by independent reading committees. Shortlisted candidates interviewed at British embassy/high commission in English.
existing.notes: For 2027-28 cycle: applications open 4 August 2026, close 6 October 2026 at 11:00 UTC. Interviews mid-February 2027; unconditional offer deadline 8 July 2027. Funded by the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO).
